father (informal)

the liquid part of a fruit or vegetable

a racket sport

the joint between the thigh and the lower leg

an outer garment extending to the waist or hips, with sleeves, a collar, and an opening down the front

piano

a large striped cat

an object for children to play with

a sweet food

the season after summer and before winter

a flat, typically round piece of metal with an official stamp, used as money

a list of dishes available in a restaurant

a large wild cat

grandfather

mom, mother

a portable computer

plate; prepared food

water bird

a baked dish

a car for hire

a substance used for washing

direct sunlight

a dish of mixed raw vegetables

liquid food

a plant or part of a plant used as food

an edible seed

a large farm animal

the mother of one's father or mother

pig

zoo

homework

sandwich

a small sweet cake

grandmother

a set of keys on a piano or computer

twelve o'clock in the daytime; midday

a carbonated soft drink
